Orthonormal contrast matrix

Source: R/matrix_k.R
bys_contrasts.Rd

bys_contrasts() returns the \((n - 1) \times n\) matrix \(\mathbf{K}_n\) whose rows are orthonormal and orthogonal to \(\mathbf{1}_n\) (Helmert contrasts). bayes_ammi() writes the main effects as \(\boldsymbol{\tau} = \mathbf{K}_G^\top\mathbf{t}\), which keeps them summing to zero.

Usage

bys_contrasts(n)

# Default S3 method
bys_contrasts(n)

Arguments

n

number of columns (at least 2).

Value

The \((n - 1) \times n\) matrix \(\mathbf{K}_n\).

Details

Row \(r\) (\(r = 1, \ldots, n - 1\)) has \(0\) in its first \(r - 1\) positions, \((n - r)/c_r\) in position \(r\) and \(-1/c_r\) after it, with \(c_r = \sqrt{(n - r)(n - r + 1)}\), so that $$\mathbf{K}_n\mathbf{K}_n^\top = \mathbf{I}_{n-1}, \qquad \mathbf{K}_n\mathbf{1}_n = \mathbf{0}, \qquad \mathbf{K}_n^\top\mathbf{K}_n = \mathbf{I}_n - \frac{1}{n}\mathbf{J}_n.$$

References

Crossa, J., Perez-Elizalde, S., Jarquin, D., Cotes, J. M., Viele, K., Liu, G. and Cornelius, P. L. (2011). Bayesian estimation of the additive main effects and multiplicative interaction model. \emphCrop Science, \strong51(4), 1458–1469. \doi10.2135/cropsci2010.06.0343

See also

bys_orthonormal

Author

Muhammad Yaseen (myaseen208@gmail.com)

Examples

K <-
  bys_contrasts(
    n = 4
  )
K
#>           [,1]       [,2]       [,3]       [,4]
#> [1,] 0.8660254 -0.2886751 -0.2886751 -0.2886751
#> [2,] 0.0000000  0.8164966 -0.4082483 -0.4082483
#> [3,] 0.0000000  0.0000000  0.7071068 -0.7071068
round(x = K %*% t(K), digits = 10)
#>      [,1] [,2] [,3]
#> [1,]    1    0    0
#> [2,]    0    1    0
#> [3,]    0    0    1
